segments.title: Pepito Sign-On, Ramaswamy Ad Controversy, JD Vance Interview, Patrick Stewart Death
segments.notes: Pepito opens broadcast with sign-on; Case discusses Vivek Ramaswamy's pulled attack ad featuring opponent's estranged mother; JD Vance appears as guest discussing midterm polls and firework injury; chat votes on news stories; Patrick Stewart death reported at 86.

segments.title: Trent Hosts Trailers: Masterminds, Playable Archive, Kunk on Cinema
segments.notes: Trent hosts trailer block with Chris; reviews Masterminds (Patrick Stewart), Playable Archive (mortuary assistant game), and Kunk on Cinema; Trent admits relating to rebellious teen hero fantasy.

segments.title: Debate in the Void: Crum Trial and Gorilla Punch Redux
segments.notes: Munch appears as talking skeleton in void; debate on whether Crum should face trial again for stealing points; options devolve into 'no' vs 'nah execution'; secondary poll for another gorilla punch to Crum's 'supple rear'; Crum claims execution immunity and detachable penis.

segments.title: Durf Hosts: Attack of the Show Halloween, Drag Dance, Archer/Fryboy, Point Four Dorito
segments.notes: Durf hosts from translucent box; videos include Attack of the Show Halloween cliffhanger, drag club dance performance, Archer/Fryboy relationship analysis, and 'point four of a Dorito' philosophical debate.

segments.title: Brandon Plays Cosmos Cosmic Adventure; Fruit Roll-Ups from Reality Hole
segments.notes: Intern fills in briefly; Brandon arrives overslept, plays vibe-coded DOS platformer Cosmos Cosmic Adventure; achieves seven intentional deaths for credits warp; reveals fruit roll-ups found in reality-warping hole; mom claims she killed intern.

segments.title: Trip Returns: Michael Myers, Shaman Mike, Cheese Question, Spider-Man, Candy Corn, AI Ban, Female Slashers
segments.notes: Trip Bradstein emerges from bushes for Halloween edition; interviews park-goers including Michael Myers actor, Shaman Mike (Valheim/Gralion lore), cheese hypothetical, Earth-6161 Spider-Man fan, candy corn minimum debate, AI ban advocate, female slasher proponent, Sovly May (Austin Creed death match), Ovali, and Mike Myers doing Austin Powers.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers sign-on, replaces self with fish picture, defends mother's honor, ends broadcast with couch-biting sermon.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors news desk, interviews JD Vance, announces Saturday stream with Fiona Nova, confirms engagement and wellness podcast progress.

characters.name: Chet
characters.notes: science correspondent. Briefly interrupts poll discussion with penis poll joke and API key confusion.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype announcer. Acknowledges subs and bits, attempts political type beat, raps about piss before being cut off.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: cultural correspondent. Hosts At the Movies trailer block with Chris, reviews Patrick Stewart and Kunk on Cinema trailers.

characters.name: Chris
characters.notes: probation officer. Co-hosts trailer block, supervises Trent's community service, advises grippy soles.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: debate analyst. Appears as immortal talking skeleton post-Sept 7 incineration, agitates for Crum's execution, claims 'all party' ideology.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: debate analyst. Claims gorilla punch execution already happened and failed, asserts detachable but functional penis, demands trial for gorilla.

characters.name: Durf
characters.notes: Amongst the Web host. Hosts from translucent box, describes writing funeral dirge album without songs or sounds from apple farm.

characters.name: Brandon
characters.notes: gaming correspondent. Plays Cosmos Cosmic Adventure, reveals fruit roll-ups from reality-warping hole, achieves credits warp via seven intentional deaths.

characters.name: Brandon's Mom
characters.notes: off-screen antagonist. Yells through bedroom door, claims she killed intern for Brandon, critiques his face as pumpkin-like.

characters.name: Intern
characters.notes: fill-in correspondent. Briefly hosts CryptoZeu$ segment while searching for Brandon, uncomfortable with smell, deemed better son than Brandon.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Returns from bush hibernation for Halloween Trip on the Street, interviews park-goers on slashers, candy corn, AI, and Spider-Man.

storylines.beat: [1:11:33] Crum claims he has already been executed by gorilla punch and died but returned; execution 'doesn't work' on him; secondary poll for another punch to 'supple rear' gains traction.
[1:07:55] Munch confirms skeleton form is permanent after Sept 7 incineration; audience claps extra hard for skeleton Munch; 'Al remains trapped inside' per Crum's prior lore.
[36:22] Case confirms engagement to Kendelle known to chat before family; [1:31:51] wellness podcast with John Madison and Kendall has 6 episodes recorded, 5 edited, targeting release next month.
[1:37:47] Brandon discovers fruit roll-ups in radiated purple/blue swirling hole in room (wider inside than outside); consumes 8000% daily sugar; mom claims she killed intern.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito replaces his on-camera feed with a picture of a fish.
Pepito's mother referenced; Pepito defends her honor when Case jokes 'Pepito takes after his mom.'
JD Vance reveals a firework exploded in his hand three to four days prior while playing with kids.
Patrick Stewart reported dead at 86; Case recalls seeing him improvise Shakespeare in Chicago.
Munch confirms he is now an immortal talking skeleton after the Sept 7, 2026 mechanical gorilla malfunction; audience claps extra hard for skeleton form.
Crum claims the gorilla punch execution already occurred and he died but returned; execution 'doesn't work' on him anymore.
Crum states his penis is detachable but somehow still functional.
Durf describes his current project as a funeral dirge album without songs or sounds, written on an apple farm.
Case confirms chat knew about his engagement to Kendelle before her family; wellness podcast with John Madison and Kendall in progress.
Brandon found a box of fruit roll-ups in a hole in his room surrounded by a reality-warping radiated purple/blue field; interior wider than exterior.
Brandon's mother claims she 'killed that intern for you, Brandy baby.'
Trip Bradstein returns from bush hibernation for Halloween Trip on the Street edition.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News delivers a Halloween-eve broadcast featuring Vice President JD Vance as a live guest discussing midterm polls and a firework injury, followed by the on-air confirmation of Patrick Stewart's death at 86. The debate desk returns with Munch now a permanent talking skeleton and Crum claiming execution immunity after a prior gorilla punch. Brandon achieves a credits warp in a vibe-coded DOS platformer after discovering reality-warping fruit roll-ups, while Trip Bradstein conducts Halloween street interviews from the park bushes.
